summary: Disc Medicine filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $189,925,765 of common stock (Nasdaq: IRON) through TD Cowen as sales agent or principal, dated November 5, 2026. Reference price was $83.28 (November 4 close). TD Cowen receives up to 3.0% of gross proceeds; sales may occur via Nasdaq, other markets, or negotiated block trades, with no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and share overhang versus clinical catalysts.
